annotations.title: Find or build Google Ads audiences

description: Audiences for Google Ads. action "search" finds affinity + in-market interests, remarketing lists, custom segments and saved audiences (query by name). "create_remarketing_list": people who visited pages matching urlRules [{operator CONTAINS|EQUALS|STARTS_WITH|ENDS_WITH, value}] in the last membershipDays (needs the Google tag on the site). "create_custom_segment": people searching keywords[] or into sites like urls[] (type AUTO or SEARCH). "create_audience": a reusable audience (userLists, interests, customSegments ids + ages like "25-34", genders) — what Performance Max signals and Demand Gen targeting take. "remove" (userList or customSegment, confirm:true). Attach with set_google_ads_audiences.

ages.description: age ranges to include: 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65+ or unknown

apps.description: app identifiers for a custom segment (create_custom_segment)

confirm.description: true to actually remove the list or segment (action remove only)

customSegments.description: custom segment ids to include in an audience, from action search

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits (dashes ok); omit for the brand's selected default account

dryRun.description: true = validate with Google and create or remove nothing

excludeUrlRules.description: same shape as urlRules; visitors to matching pages are left out of the list

value.description: URL fragment to exclude, same rules as urlRules[].value

genders.description: genders to include: male, female or unknown

interests.description: interest ids (affinity or in-market) to include in an audience, from action search

keywords.description: search phrases for a custom segment, 10 words or fewer each (create_custom_segment)

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one

name.description: audience or list name, unique on the account (create actions)

query.description: search text matched against audience and interest names (action search)

type.description: custom segment type: AUTO (Google decides, default) or SEARCH (people who searched the keywords)

urlRules.description: visitor rules for create_remarketing_list: [{operator, value}]; visitors to pages matching any rule

value.description: URL fragment to match, e.g. /pricing; no quotes, tabs, newlines or parentheses

urls.description: full http(s) URLs of sites like yours for a custom segment (create_custom_segment)

userLists.description: user list ids to include in an audience (create_audience), from action search

name: manage_google_ads_audience
title: Find or build Google Ads audiences
